profile.name: Linda Morales
profile.summary: Administrative assistant with five years of experience supporting busy offices in finance and health care. Organized, calm with a full calendar, and comfortable with Microsoft 365, scheduling systems and basic bookkeeping.

descriptions: Manage calendars and travel for three partners and a team of 12 advisers
Prepare client meeting packets and keep the client file system up to date
Process about 80 expense reports a month and reconcile the office credit card
Set up a shared request form that replaced most of the team's scheduling emails
Scheduled appointments for four providers and handled insurance checks at check-in
Ordered office and clinical supplies, keeping spending within the monthly budget
Trained two new front desk staff on scheduling and patient privacy rules
Kept the referral log current and followed up on missing paperwork with other offices
Greeted about 100 patients and visitors a day and answered a busy phone line
Kept visitor logs and badges in order for a 90-bed hospital
